import { Source } from "@storybook/blocks";

Each column passed to the DataTable component can be configured with the following properties.
<Source code={`{
  // column alignment (right for numeric columns)
  align?: "left" | "right"
  // sorting and resizing are enabled by default
  disableResizing?: Boolean
  disableSortBy?: Boolean
  // See https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/api/core/column-def
  id?: String
  accessorKey?: String | Function(originalRow, rowIndex):any
  accessorFn?: Function(originalRow, rowIndex):any
  cell?: Function | React.Component
  header?: String | Function | React.Component
  // See https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/api/features/column-sizing#column-def-options
  size?: Number
  minSize?: Number
  maxSize?: Number
  // See https://tanstack.com/table/v8/docs/api/features/sorting#column-def-options
  invertSorting?: Boolean
  sortDescFirst?: Boolean
  sortingFn?: String | SortingFn
}`} />

Here is the configuration used in this documentation.
<Source code={`
// custom row data type
type ExampleRowData = {
  creation: string;
  start?: string;
  end?: string;
  city?: string;
  opt?: string;
  type?: string;
  fir?: string;
  count?: number;
  longDesc?: string;
};
// custom sub rows data type
export type ExampleSubRowData = {
  test1: string;
  test2: string;
};
// custom columns definition
// "longDesc" is ommited as it is only used in expandable rows
const columns: DataTableColumnDef<ExampleRowData>[] = [
  {
    header: "Creation",
    id: "creation",
    accessorFn: (row) => new Date(row.creation),
    cell: (value) => value.getValue().toLocaleDateString(),
    sortingFn: "datetime",
    size: 100,
    disableResizing: true,
  },
  { header: "City", accessorKey: "city", size: 90 },
  { header: "OPT", accessorKey: "opt", size: 180 },
  { header: "Type", accessorKey: "type", size: 180 },
  {
    header: "FIR",
    accessorKey: "fir",
    size: 60,
    disableSortBy: true,
    cell: (value) => (value.getValue() ? value.getValue() : "-"),
  },
  {
    header: "Count",
    accessorKey: "count",
    size: 90,
    sortingFn: "alphanumeric",
    align: "right"
  },
];`} />
